JobProjection.description:
IN-2 whitelist: the only job fields Career Coach can read. Every field
is used by a named rule; nothing else on ProcessedJob is reachable.
JobProjection.title: JobProjection

SkillEvidence.description:
One extracted technical concept for one job, with the provenance
needed to explain *why* it was extracted and *why* it was given its
importance. Not a score — a record of evidence.

importance: "required" | "preferred" | "unknown".
"unknown" means the posting gave no reliable signal about how much the
concept matters (e.g. it only appears in prose outside any recognised
requirements/preferred section). It is deliberately NOT the same as
"preferred".
SkillEvidence.title: SkillEvidence

WorkAuthorizationEvidence.description:
One piece of job-side citizenship/work-authorization language, with
the provenance needed to show *why* HC-2 reached its status. Not a
decision — a record of evidence (same role as SkillEvidence).

restriction_type:
  FOREIGNERS_NOT_ACCEPTED    explicit "no foreigners"-style exclusion
  NATIONALITY_SPECIFIC       explicit "X citizens only"-style exclusion
  OTHER_EXPLICIT_RESTRICTION a stated condition that does NOT deny all
                             foreign applicants (work permit required,
                             no sponsorship, SC/PR only, "local candidates
                             only", or foreigners accepted conditionally)
  NONE                       explicit openness to foreign applicants
  UNKNOWN                    relevant language that establishes no
                             restriction either way (e.g. "Malaysians
                             preferred")
Only the first two can make HC-2 FAIL.
WorkAuthorizationEvidence.title: WorkAuthorizationEvidence
